# Introduction

The **`jwaffle`** analysis (Waffle Charts) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- 'Creates waffle charts to visualize categorical distributions and proportions using colored squares. Ideal for showing parts-of-whole relationships in clinical data such as disease subtypes, treatment outcomes, or risk category distributions. Each square represents a proportion of the total sample, making it easy to see relative frequencies across categories.'
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("jwaffle_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::jwaffle(
#   data = jwaffle_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `jwaffle` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
